entities.summary: The Jubilee Synagogue, also known as the Jerusalem Synagogue, is an active Orthodox Jewish synagogue, located on Jerusalem Street in the Nové Město district of Prague, in the Czech Republic. It is currently the largest synagogue in Prague, although not the largest in the country.
